question.text: The transition from FMC to SEBI regulation brought which key change to commodity markets?

answer.text: After FCRA repeal, commodity derivatives came under SEBI/SCRA and were integrated with securities derivatives markets, broking activities, operating frameworks, and trading across exchanges
Reduced regulation and fewer compliance requirements
Separate regulatory standards for each commodity type

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes FCRA repeal, SEBI regulation of commodity derivatives, and integration of commodity derivatives with securities derivatives markets, participants, brokers, operational frameworks, and single-exchange trading. The Trap: Regulation was not reduced, standards were not split per commodity, and margin requirements were not eliminated. Note: The pages checked do not specifically claim unification with currency derivatives or characterise the change as "better surveillance" or "stronger enforcement", so those phrasings are intentionally avoided.
